notes.title: 20250518 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue with incorrect water levels
2.Optimized UI content and display
3.Improved jump responsiveness
4.Enhanced room layout and guidance

notes.title: 20250516 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed collision issues with marbles (preventing clipping).
Improved level guidance in specific stages.

notes.title: 20250513 Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue where marbles could get stuck on ladders in certain scenarios.
2.Fixed an issue where doors would not open properly after loading a saved game.
3.Fixed incorrect UI alignment in map button prompts.
4.Fixed animation errors when pushing box under certain conditions.
5.Fixed an issue where players could get stuck while climbing ladders.
6.Resolved soft-lock and level-skipping issues in some rooms.

notes.title: 20250509 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where marble could get stuck outside tube.  
2. Fixed incorrect sound effects for marbles.  
3. Added the ability to jump while on ladders.  
4. Added a low-stamina warning alert.  
5. Optimized menu UI interaction logic.  
6. Increased stamina consumption when jumping in water.  
7. Added mouse cursor display in small-screen mode.  
8. Improved color contrast between certain backgrounds and foregrounds.  
9. Resolved soft-lock issues in some level designs.  
10. Added an automatic prompt when the playtest ends.

notes.title: 20250506 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue where key bindings could not be set in certain scenes.
2.Resolved conflicts when binding multiple keys simultaneously.
3.Added English translations for key binding settings.

notes.title: 20250504 Keyboard Key Rebinding Support
notes.content:
New Feature: Customizable Key Bindings
（Some keyboards have a limit on how many letter keys can be pressed simultaneously, which may affect gameplay smoothness）

notes.title: 20250503 Save File Conflict Fix
notes.content: Resolved the save file compatibility issue between versions 2.0.1 and 2.0.2.

notes.title: 20250501 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed UI interaction logic errors.
2.Updated content on the start screen.
3.Added windowed mode option in the settings menu.
4.Fixed incorrect English voice-over in the opening cinematic.

notes.title: Minor Patch Update
notes.content: Updated a small number of patches based on feedback.

notes.title: Fixed multiple bugs.
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where some walls and background colors were too similar.  

Fixed the character lighting flicker problem.  

Fixed loading and exit read errors.  

Modified the interaction logic for UI and mouse.  

Fixed the error where room switching failed.  

Fixed interaction errors between marbles and pipes.  

Fixed some errors with the sound effects of marbles and doors.  

Modified the recognition logic for interactive objects.  

Reduced the probability of accidentally triggering iron blocks.  

Added directional keys to stand up from a chair.  

Reduced the probability of being killed by a marble.  

Various other minor changes.

notes.title: Fixed some crash bugs.
notes.content: Based on testing feedback, some known crash bugs have been fixed.
